claims.statement: Panasonic CGR26650A is a bare 26650 high-rate cell, approximately 26.5 mm x 65.2 mm; aggregate records identify it as flat-top and unprotected.
Steam Engine preserves Panasonic CGR26650A 2650mAh 50A as a 2650mAh preset with a 50A runtime rating.
Panasonic CGR26650A is documented as a lithium-ion cell, but the exact cathode chemistry was not established in this pass.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for Panasonic CGR26650A in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
